cues.en: And the second one, which is also really important, is to give you an example of writing something like a short report.
cues.zh: 第二也很重要，是示範如何寫類似短報告的內容。

cues.en: This is a beautiful formatted report that you can hand in to your teacher, and he or she will be very, very impressed.
cues.zh: 這是一份排版漂亮、能繳給老師的報告，他或她一定非常驚艷。

cues.en: And if they're not impressed, then you tell them to talk to me and I will make them be impressed.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，就叫他們來找我，我會讓他們驚艷。
